description: Have Ironflow post to the user's Discord, Slack, Telegram or HTTPS webhook as things happen on Hyperliquid. It keeps running after the conversation: use it when the user wants to be told, not just to see something now. signal picks what it posts: leave it out for liquidations within seconds (filtered by markets, side, min_usd and address; any key, a free key works); position_risk to warn before wallets are liquidated ("warn me when any of these wallets gets within 5% of liquidation": addresses and threshold_pct; Explorer plan and up); liquidation_pressure, opening_bell or flow_ahead for Ironflow's edge signals (Pro plan). Needs an API key. A plan refusal says which plan the user needs and links it: pass it on as it is. Give url (a Discord channel webhook, a Slack incoming webhook or any public https URL) or telegram_chat (then tell the user to add the bot named in the result's setup). A plain webhook gets signed JSON; its signing_secret appears only in this result, so pass it on. Then call test_liquidation_alert.

address.description: Liquidations only: only this wallet's liquidations (0x...). For position_risk use addresses

addresses.description: position_risk only, and required there: the wallets to watch (0x...), e.g. a user's or a fund's accounts. A comma-separated string works too. The plan limits how many wallets all of an account's position risk alerts watch (Explorer 10, Builder 200, Pro 1,000).

markets.description: Comma-separated markets, e.g. BTC,ETH-PERP,xyz:NVDA (Hyperliquid names work); omit for every market

min_usd.description: Smallest amount in USD (default 0): the liquidation (100000 keeps a channel readable), the position's value (position_risk), the notional at risk (liquidation_pressure) or the USD left to execute (flow_ahead)

name.description: Label shown in each message, e.g. BTC whales

side.description: Default any. Liquidations: long = longs liquidated. position_risk: long = long positions only. liquidation_pressure: long = longs at risk. flow_ahead: long = buy TWAPs, short = sell TWAPs

signal.description: What to post; omit for liquidations. position_risk: a warning when a position of one of addresses gets within threshold_pct of its liquidation price, and a last message if that wallet is liquidated (Explorer and up). liquidation_pressure: a market side entering high liquidation pressure. opening_bell: the 09:29 New York pre-open preview of the HIP-3 stock perps in markets. flow_ahead: a new TWAP order with at least $250,000 left to execute. The last three are on Pro.

telegram_chat.description: A Telegram chat instead of url: @channel or group name, or a numeric chat id (-100...)

threshold_pct.description: position_risk only: warn when a position's mark price is within this percent of its liquidation price, 1 to 50 (default 10)

url.description: Where to post: https://discord.com/api/webhooks/..., https://hooks.slack.com/services/... or a public https URL (or use telegram_chat)

name: create_liquidation_alert

destination.description: Host it posts to, without the secret part of the URL

last_sent_at.description: Last delivery, RFC 3339; null before the first

markets.description: Markets watched; empty means every market

notice.description: A note from the API: how a market name was read, why data starts later than asked, or a next step such as a free key

setup.description: What to do before the first message arrives (Telegram: the bot to add to the chat)

signal.description: position_risk, liquidation_pressure, opening_bell or flow_ahead; absent on a liquidation alert

signing_secret.description: Webhooks only: HMAC key for the X-Ironflow-Signature header, shown only here

status.description: active or disabled (after 20 failed deliveries in a row)

threshold_pct.description: position_risk only: warns when mark is within this percent of the liquidation price

title: Create liquidation alert
